description: When the owner needs a provider, method, country or corridor PaidRouter doesn't cover yet (get_fees came back empty, or compare_send_money doesn't know the corridor), send what they need. PaidRouter records it, counts it on https://paidrouter.com/coverage, and adds the most-requested coverage every week with the date. Returns what is covered today that comes closest.

country.description: Country or currency involved, if any

kind.description: What the owner is trying to do

note.description: Anything that helps, e.g. the amount or how often

what.description: Provider, method or corridor, e.g. 'QuickBooks Payments', 'Wise → Philippines', 'paying a supplier by ACH', 'GBP receiving'

name: request_route
title: Request coverage
